title: External validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models: a systematic review.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 临床预测模型外部验证与临床落地：系统综述
summary: 横断面元流行病学研究追踪1072个机器学习临床预测模型（2017–2019年发表），发现仅9.9%完成外部验证、5.2%进入临床实施。
key_points: 1072个ML预测模型中88.1%无转化随访
公开代码与TRIPOD依从性提高转化几率
外部验证与临床实施呈阶段性而非连续路径
reason: 系统综述纳入1072项研究、结论明确，属系统综述可及7分档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To assess whether external validation and clinical implementation of clinical prediction models reflect sequential or distinct stages of a translational pathway. This cross-sectional meta-epidemiologic study analyzed 1072 machine learning-based clinical prediction models published across clinical domains (2017-2019). We assessed downstream external validation and clinical implementation via citation screening through August 2025. Evaluated exposures included public code availability, TRIPOD adherence, multicenter design, and sample size. Secondary outcomes included investigator overlap. Among 1072 studies, 88.1% lacked translational follow-up. Only 9.9% underwent external validation, and 5.2% reached clinical implementation. Code availability (odds ratio [OR] 3.04; 95% CI, 1.91-4.84) and higher TRIPOD adherence (OR 2.68 per 10% increase; 95% CI, 2.04-3.52) were significantly associated with external validation, but not consistently with clinical implementation. Notably, 39% of implemented models lacked prior external validation. Independent groups predominantly conducted external validation (72.6%), whereas implementation frequently involved original development teams. Findings indicate a divergence in algorithmic translation. Characteristics emphasizing evaluability (code availability, reporting transparency) facilitate external validation but do not ensure clinical implementation. The frequent bypass of independent validation before implementation highlights a reliance on institutional and operational factors rather than generalizable methodology. External validation and clinical implementation appear to represent distinct translational processes rather than sequential stages influenced by a uniform set of factors. Current practices facilitate validation but inadequately address operational requirements for real-world deployment.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 评估临床预测模型的外部验证和临床实施是否反映转化路径中的连续阶段还是不同阶段。这项横断面元流行病学研究分析了 2017-2019 年在各临床领域发表的 1072 个基于机器学习的临床预测模型。我们通过截至 2025 年 8 月的引文筛选评估了下游外部验证和临床实施。评估的暴露因素包括公共代码可用性、TRIPOD 依从性、多中心设计和样本量。次要结局包括研究者重叠。在 1072 项研究中，88.1% 缺乏转化随访。仅 9.9% 进行了外部验证，5.2% 达到临床实施。代码可用性（比值比 [OR] 3.04；95% CI，1.91-4.84）和更高的 TRIPOD 依从性（每增加 10%，OR 2.68；95% CI，2.04-3.52）与外部验证显著相关，但与临床实施并不一致相关。值得注意的是，39% 已实施的模型缺乏先前外部验证。独立团队主要进行外部验证（72.6%），而实施常涉及原始开发团队。研究结果表明算法转化存在分歧。强调可评估性的特征（代码可用性、报告透明度）促进外部验证，但不确保临床实施。实施前经常绕过独立验证，凸显对机构和操作因素的依赖，而非可推广的方法学。外部验证和临床实施似乎代表不同的转化过程，而不是受一组统一因素影响的连续阶段。当前实践促进了验证，但不足以满足真实世界部署的操作要求。

title: Subgroup deployment-readiness audit of calibration and clinical utility in perioperative infection prediction.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 围手术期感染预测模型的分组校准与部署就绪度审计
summary: JAMIA 同行评审研究：对 10719 例手术的术后感染预测模型按性别、年龄与生理储备亚组审计校准与临床效用，并比较多种重校准策略。
key_points: 10 719 例手术、504 例术后感染事件，总体 AUROC 0.876
评估亚组判别力、校准、阈值误差与决策曲线净收益

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] We audited deployment readiness of an end-of-surgery postoperative infection model across clinically relevant subgroups and assessed mitigation of subgroup miscalibration. We analyzed out-of-fold predictions from 10 719 procedures (2014-2022) with 504 present-on-admission (POA)-coded postoperative infection events across recorded sex, age, and a clinical physiological-reserve proxy. We assessed discrimination, calibration, threshold-specific errors, and decision-curve net benefit, treating t = 0.10 as a reference anchor. We compared no recalibration with common and group-specific cross-fitted isotonic recalibration, evaluated a refit without the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE), and performed a temporal-holdout analysis. Overall area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.876, with similar sex-marginal discrimination in women and men (0.878 vs 0.875). Calibration-in-the-large was -1.02 overall, -0.86 in frail, and -1.34 in prefrail patients; the 6-event nonfrail stratum was not estimable. At t = 0.10, net benefit was positive in frail and negative in prefrail patients in the source cohort, but negative prefrail utility did not persist in the ascertainable-period (2018-2022) and temporal analyses. Common recalibration moved overall calibration-in-the-large from -1.020 to -0.007. Removing SMOTE shifted overall calibration but did not reduce the reserve gradient. Temporal-holdout AUROC was 0.851 with persistent overprediction. Present-on-admission coding was effectively absent before 2018; prevalence-dependent results were therefore additionally reported for the ascertainable 2018-2022 period, and ascertainment differed by physiological reserve. Discrimination-only or sex-marginal evaluation would have missed deployment-relevant subgroup heterogeneity, while endpoint ascertainment affected prevalence-dependent interpretation. Joint subgroup evaluation can identify deployment-relevant limitations missed by aggregate metrics. Prospective validation with comparable outcome ascertainment remains necessary before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA] 我们审计了一个手术结束时术后感染模型在临床相关亚组中的部署就绪度，并评估了对亚组校准不良的缓解情况。我们分析了10 719例手术（2014-2022年）的折外预测，其中包含504例入院时存在（present-on-admission，POA）编码的术后感染事件，并按记录的性别、年龄和一个临床生理储备替代指标进行分析。我们评估了区分度、校准、阈值特异性错误和决策曲线净获益，将 t = 0.10 作为参考锚点。我们将不重新校准与共同的和组特异性的交叉拟合等渗重校准进行比较，评估了不使用合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）的重新拟合，并进行了时间留出分析。总体受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.876，女性和男性的性别边际区分度相似（0.878 vs 0.875）。整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）总体为 -1.02，衰弱患者为 -0.86，前衰弱患者为 -1.34；6个事件的非衰弱层不可估计。在 t = 0.10 时，源队列中衰弱患者的净获益为正，前衰弱患者为负，但前衰弱患者的负效用未在可确定期（2018-2022年）和时间分析中持续存在。共同重校准将总体整体校准从 -1.020 变为 -0.007。移除SMOTE改变了总体校准，但未降低储备梯度。时间留出 AUROC 为 0.851，并持续存在过度预测。入院时存在编码在2018年前实际上缺失；因此，还报告了可确定期2018-2022年的患病率依赖结果，且确定情况因生理储备而异。仅区分度或性别边际评估会漏掉与部署相关的亚组异质性，而终点确定影响患病率依赖的解释。联合亚组评估可以识别被总体指标漏掉的部署相关局限性。在临床部署前，仍需要具有可比结局确定的前瞻性验证。

title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
zh_title: 模拟环境强化学习训练精神科接诊语言模型
summary: 预印本显示，多轮强化学习训练的模型在结构化精神科接诊中优于同源基座模型。
key_points: 随机双盲交叉，120次访谈
15名精神科医师独立盲评记录
76.7%配对场景优于基座模型
reason: 随机双盲交叉+精神科医师盲评属重要档，但为预印本且场景模拟，不给更高
abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.
zh_abstract: 在精神科实践中，临床接诊访谈仍是主要的诊断工具，要求临床医生在建立融洽关系的同时，理清复杂且相互重叠的表现。在此，我们展示，模拟环境中的多轮强化学习（reinforcement learning, RL）可提高语言模型在结构化文本精神科接诊中的表现，涵盖病史采集、鉴别诊断和初始管理计划。在一项随机、双盲交叉研究中（$N = 60$ 对匹配场景，120次接诊），将经RL训练的智能体与接受相同提示的基础模型进行比较，32名委员会认证的精神科医生角色扮演标准化患者，而由另一个由15名独立、委员会认证的精神科医生组成的小组对去标识化转录文本进行评分。训练后智能体在76.7%的匹配场景对中优于基础模型（$p < 0.0001$），并在改编的临床检查评分量表（$d_z = 0.77$，$p < 0.0001$）、以患者为中心的沟通（82.0% 对 65.2%，$p < 0.001$）和鉴别诊断适当性（68.3% 对 33.3%，$p < 0.001$）方面均有改善。在127个经精神科医生验证的模拟接诊场景中，训练后智能体的临床评分量表得分几乎为基础模型的两倍（0.706 对 0.379；复合奖励 0.564 对 0.294，$p < 0.0001$）。为系统探究对话安全性，我们建立了两个德尔菲共识分类体系，分别关于临床安全风险和关系能力，并从中衍生出256个具有挑战性的对抗性表现；我们发现，在模拟环境中进行训练使急性安全风险的分诊不足减少了一半以上（12.9% 对 30.5%，$p < 0.0001$）。因此，模拟环境为训练和压力测试精神科对话智能体提供了受控测试平台，其收益可迁移至由精神科医生实施的接诊中，但残余差距仍需要保障措施和临床医生监督。

title: An uncertainty-aware deep learning-based registration model for adaptive lung cancer radiotherapy.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: 不确定性感知深度学习配准模型用于肺癌自适应放疗
summary: 提出变分贝叶斯配准模型TransMorph-prob，预测位移场均值与方差，用于肺癌MR引导放疗的剂量累积不确定性评估。
key_points: 变分贝叶斯模型预测体素级位移场均值与方差
在725例CT与102例MR-linac数据上训练
DIRLAB及独立MR-linac数据外部基准测试
reason: 同行评审方法学研究，有公开基准外部验证，但为回顾性配准精度评估、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] To develop a deep learning (DL) based probabilistic 3D deformable image registration framework for uncertainty-aware dose accumulation in magnetic resonance imaging-guided radiotherapy (MRgRT) of lung cancer. Approach: We propose TransMorph-prob (TM-prob), a variational Bayesian model that predicts the voxel-wise mean and variance of dense displacement fields (DDFs). Two TM-prob models were trained on an internal CT dataset (725 patients) and a low-field MR-linac dataset (102 patients), and benchmarked against Monte Carlo dropout TransMorph (TM-MCD) and DIRUncertainty with B-spline initialization (ASDIR) on the DIRLAB 4DCT dataset (10 patients, 3000 landmarks), and an annotated MR-linac dataset (16 patients, 107 image pairs, 227 landmarks) with target and seven organ-at-risk (OAR) contours. Both datasets contained an additional 1239/13,289 algorithm-generated landmarks. Performance was evaluated using target registration error (TRE), Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), landmark- and voxel-wise expected calibration errors (LECE/ECE), and dose distributions derived from 2000 DDF samples per patient. Main results: On the DIRLAB dataset, TM-prob achieved a median TRE of \qty{1.8}{\mm}/\qty{2.8}{\mm} on manual/algorithm-generated landmarks, versus \qty{1.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.4}{\mm} for ASDIR and \qty{2.1}{\mm}/\qty{3.0}{\mm} for TM-MCD. On the MRI dataset, TM-prob achieved the median TRE of \qty{3.9}{\mm}/\qty{2.6}{\mm} and a mean DSC of 0.87, matching ASDIR (\qty{3.3}{\mm}/\qty{2.7}{\mm}, and DSC of 0.87) while outperforming TM-MCD (\qty{4.4}{\mm}/\qty{2.9}{\mm}, and 0.84). In uncertainty calibration, TM-prob achieved a LECE of \qty{1.74}{\mm}/\qty{0.30}{\mm} on MRI manual/algorithm-generated landmarks versus \qty{2.41}{\mm}/\qty{0.56}{\mm} for ASDIR and \qty{6.65}{\mm}/\qty{3.92}{\mm} for TM-MCD, and an average contour ECE of 5.8% versus 7.0% and 21.2%. Two patients with indistinct GTV boundaries exhibited substantially wider target D95 distributions, demonstrating that calibrated DDF uncertainty translates into clinically relevant dose-coverage uncertainty. Significance: TM-prob is an end-to-end DL model, achieving fast, well-calibrated, uncertainty-aware registration for lung cancer patients, enabling reliable DDF uncertainty propagation into dose accumulation for clinical decision-making in online adaptive radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 【目的】开发一个基于深度学习（DL）的概率性 3D 可变形图像配准框架，用于肺癌磁共振成像引导放疗（MRgRT）中考虑不确定性的剂量累积。【方法】我们提出 TransMorph-prob（TM-prob），一种变分贝叶斯模型，可预测稠密位移场（DDF）的体素级均值和方差。两个 TM-prob 模型分别在内部 CT 数据集（725 名患者）和低场 MR-linac 数据集（102 名患者）上训练，并在 DIRLAB 4DCT 数据集（10 名患者，3000 个标志点）和带靶区及七个危及器官（OAR）轮廓标注的 MR-linac 数据集（16 名患者，107 对图像，227 个标志点）上与蒙特卡洛 dropout TransMorph（TM-MCD）和带 B 样条初始化的 DIRUncertainty（ASDIR）进行基准比较。两个数据集额外包含 1239/13,289 个算法生成标志点。性能使用靶区配准误差（TRE）、Dice 相似系数（DSC）、标志点和体素级期望校准误差（LECE/ECE），以及每名患者 2000 个 DDF 样本得出的剂量分布进行评估。【主要结果】在 DIRLAB 数据集上，TM-prob 在手动/算法生成标志点上的中位 TRE 为 1.8 mm/2.8 mm，而 ASDIR 为 1.3 mm/2.4 mm，TM-MCD 为 2.1 mm/3.0 mm。在 MRI 数据集上，TM-prob 的中位 TRE 为 3.9 mm/2.6 mm，平均 DSC 为 0.87，与 ASDIR（3.3 mm/2.7 mm，DSC 为 0.87）相当，同时优于 TM-MCD（4.4 mm/2.9 mm，DSC 为 0.84）。在不确定性校准中，TM-prob 在 MRI 手动/算法生成标志点上的 LECE 为 1.74 mm/0.30 mm，而 ASDIR 为 2.41 mm/0.56 mm，TM-MCD 为 6.65 mm/3.92 mm；平均轮廓 ECE 为 5.8%，而 ASDIR 和 TM-MCD 分别为 7.0% 和 21.2%。两名 GTV 边界不清的患者表现出明显更宽的目标 D95 分布，表明校准后的 DDF 不确定性可转化为临床相关的剂量覆盖不确定性。【意义】TM-prob 是一种端到端 DL 模型，为肺癌患者实现快速、校准良好且考虑不确定性的配准，使 DDF 不确定性能够可靠传播到剂量累积中，用于在线自适应放疗的临床决策。

abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are proposed for clinical prediction but are untested in pediatrics, where cohorts are small and outcomes are uncommon. Using records from 2,489 youth with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and 4,018 with type 1 diabetes (T1D), spanning structured data, note-derived social determinants and, in T1D, continuous glucose monitoring data, we predicted seven T2D outcomes, four also in T1D, at 24 months from 18 months of follow-up. CEDAR (Clinical Evidence-Driven Agent for Risk-prediction), an evidence-citing, self-auditing LLM pipeline, outperformed trained machine learning in both cohorts (pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.815 versus 0.656 to 0.700 in T2D and 0.756 versus 0.603 to 0.631 in T1D), most on the sparsely screened outcomes. Only 4 of 70,246 values it cited did not match the chart. Reading only the evidence and reasoning cited by CEDAR, two pediatric endocrinologists reached the same prediction as CEDAR in about nine of ten cases, agreeing with each other on 90.5%.

abstract: [ERJ open research] Diagnosis of asthma and/or COPD is challenging due to overlapping clinical and physiological characteristics; however, due to varying treatment recommendations, determining the correct diagnosis is vital to clinical care. Hyperpolarised xenon-129 ventilation (129Xe)-magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides high spatial resolution three-dimensional images of gas distribution within the lungs. Recently, artificial intelligence (AI)-based models have successfully classified pulmonary pathologies via medical images, but due to their black-box nature, clinical application is challenging. Here, we aim to develop an explainable AI framework to classify patients with asthma and/or COPD using 129Xe-MRI alone. 129Xe-MRI from 207 patients with asthma and/or COPD were classified using a vision transformer (ViT) and a convolutional neural network (CNN). Regional visualisations of areas of importance (AOIs) associated with each diagnosis were generated. Regional patterns were investigated to develop a shape-based metric which quantified asthma-like and COPD-like features. The ViT accurately classified asthma and/or COPD patients in 83% (n=25/30) of cases (area under the curve (AUC) 0.86, F1 score 0.82), outperforming the CNN (AUC 0.71, F1 score 0.62). Patients with asthma had more diffuse, elongated AOIs associated with disease grouping while patients with COPD had more focal, spherical AOIs. The proposed sphericity score weakly correlated with conventional lung function metrics in clinically understandable ways. When applied to patients with overlapping features of asthma and COPD (asthma+COPD), the classification framework informed the prevalence and regional distribution of asthma-like and COPD-like features. Explainable AI classification of 129Xe-MRI could facilitate diagnosis of patients with asthma and/or COPD, including determining the prevalence of asthma-like or COPD-like features in patients with asthma+COPD, potentially informing management and treatment.
zh_abstract: [ERJ开放研究] 哮喘和/或COPD的诊断具有挑战性，因为临床和生理特征存在重叠；然而，由于治疗建议不同，确定正确诊断对临床诊疗至关重要。超极化氙-129通气（129Xe）磁共振成像（MRI）可提供肺部内气体分布的高空间分辨率三维图像。最近，基于人工智能（AI）的模型已通过医学图像成功对肺部病变进行分类，但由于其黑箱性质，临床应用具有挑战性。在此，我们旨在开发一个可解释的AI框架，仅使用129Xe-MRI对哮喘和/或COPD患者进行分类。使用视觉Transformer（ViT）和卷积神经网络（CNN）对207例哮喘和/或COPD患者的129Xe-MRI进行分类。生成了与每种诊断相关的重要区域（areas of importance，AOIs）的区域可视化。研究了区域模式，以开发一种基于形状的指标，该指标量化了哮喘样和COPD样特征。ViT在83%（n=25/30）的病例中准确分类了哮喘和/或COPD患者（曲线下面积（AUC）0.86，F1分数0.82），优于CNN（AUC 0.71，F1分数0.62）。哮喘患者具有与疾病分组相关的更弥漫、细长的AOI，而COPD患者具有更局灶、球形的AOI。所提出的球形度评分以临床可理解的方式与传统肺功能指标弱相关。当应用于具有哮喘和COPD重叠特征的患者（asthma+COPD）时，该分类框架提供了哮喘样和COPD样特征的患病率和区域分布信息。129Xe-MRI的可解释AI分类可促进哮喘和/或COPD患者的诊断，包括确定asthma+COPD患者中哮喘样或COPD样特征的患病率，可能为管理和治疗提供信息。

title: Artificial intelligence-powered solutions for environmental sustainability in medical imaging: a scoping review.
source: PubMed · Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)

summary: 范围综述检索八个数据库，纳入23项研究，梳理AI用于降低医学影像环境影响的可能途径。
key_points: 检索8个数据库，纳入23项研究

abstract: [Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)] Growing evidence shows that medical imaging has a substantial environmental impact. With the increasing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in clinical settings, it is important to explore how this technology may support environmental sustainability. Literature searches were performed across eight databases (PubMed, Wiley Online Library, Embase, Web of Science platform, the Cochrane Library, Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature Ultimate, Google Scholar, and MedRxiv) for the period January 2020-June 2026. Full-text sources in the English language were eligible for inclusion. The Joanna Briggs Institute checklists were employed for risk of bias assessment. All data were analyzed using a textual narrative synthesis. In total, 23 studies were deemed eligible for inclusion. The literature proposed that AI tools in medical imaging could be used to minimize energy consumption by optimizing patient scheduling, decreasing scanner idle times and workstation use, reducing computed tomography over-scanning, contrast agent usage, and radiation dose, harnessing low-field magnetic resonance imaging, and curtailing low-value imaging. However, AI technologies may also impact the environment in harmful ways. Although AI-powered solutions hold promise for improving sustainability in medical imaging, the true environmental impact remains largely unexplored. The findings of this work further strengthen the dual role of AI adoption in medical imaging related to environmental sustainability.
zh_abstract: [诊断与介入放射学（Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology，安卡拉，土耳其）] 越来越多的证据表明，医学影像具有显著的环境影响。随着人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）在临床环境中的采用日益增加，探索该技术如何支持环境可持续性十分重要。文献检索覆盖八个数据库（PubMed、Wiley Online Library、Embase、Web of Science 平台、Cochrane Library、Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature Ultimate、Google Scholar 和 MedRxiv），检索时段为2020年1月至2026年6月。英文全文来源符合纳入条件。采用 Joanna Briggs Institute 清单进行偏倚风险评估。所有数据均采用文本叙述综合进行分析。共有23项研究被认为符合纳入条件。文献提出，医学影像中的AI工具可通过优化患者排程、减少扫描仪空闲时间和工作站使用、减少计算机断层扫描过度扫描、对比剂使用和辐射剂量、利用低场磁共振成像以及削减低价值影像检查来最小化能耗。然而，AI技术也可能以有害方式影响环境。尽管AI驱动的解决方案有望改善医学影像的可持续性，其真实环境影响仍在很大程度上未被探索。本研究结果进一步强化了医学影像中AI采用与环境可持续性相关的双重作用。

title: AI-Assisted Instruction Versus Peer Learning for Sustained Lumbar Puncture Competency
zh_title: AI 辅助教学与同伴学习对腰椎穿刺技能保持的比较
summary: ClinicalTrials.gov 新注册、已完成但无结果的随机试验，比较传统床旁、同伴互助与 AI 智能模拟人三种腰椎穿刺教学方法。
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University, School of Medicine; conditions: Lumbar Puncture; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 100; status: COMPLETED] This study compared three teaching methods for training resident physicians in lumbar puncture, a critical medical procedure used to collect spinal fluid for diagnosing conditions like meningitis. One hundred thirty-five residents were randomly assigned to either traditional bedside teaching, peer-assisted learning (where trainees practiced in pairs and gave each other feedback), or artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted training using a smart simulator that provided real-time voice feedback on technique. All residents were tested immediately after training and again three months later to see how well they retained their skills. Right after training, all three groups performed equally well. However, after three months, both the peer-learning and AI groups scored significantly higher on practical skills than the traditional group, showing that these newer methods help slow skill decay. The AI group showed the greatest advantages in procedural standardization, pre-procedure assessment, post-procedure care, and operating speed. Meanwhile, residents in the peer-learning group reported the highest satisfaction with classroom interaction and teaching methods. In short, while all three approaches work well for short-term training, AI-assisted and peer-assisted learning are more effective than traditional teaching at helping residents maintain their lumbar puncture skills over time, with AI excelling in technical precision and efficiency, and peer learning offering a more engaging and collaborative learning experience.

zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：浙江大学医学院附属第二医院；疾病：腰椎穿刺；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组：100；状态：已完成] 本研究比较了三种培训住院医师进行腰椎穿刺的教学方法，腰椎穿刺是一种用于采集脑脊液以诊断脑膜炎等疾病的关键医疗操作。135名住院医师被随机分配到传统床旁教学、同伴辅助学习（学员成对练习并互相反馈）或使用智能模拟器的人工智能（AI）辅助培训，该模拟器提供关于操作技术的实时语音反馈。所有住院医师在培训后立即接受测试，并在三个月后再次测试，以观察其技能保留情况。培训后立即，三组表现同样好。然而，三个月后，同伴学习组和AI组在实践技能上的得分均显著高于传统组，表明这些较新的方法有助于减缓技能衰退。AI组在操作标准化、操作前评估、操作后护理和操作速度方面表现出最大优势。同时，同伴学习组的住院医师对课堂互动和教学方法的满意度最高。简而言之，虽然三种方法在短期培训中均效果良好，但AI辅助和同伴辅助学习在帮助住院医师随时间保持腰椎穿刺技能方面比传统教学更有效，其中AI在技术精确性和效率方面表现出色，而同伴学习提供更具参与性和协作性的学习体验。

abstract: Purpose. Characterizing glioma heterogeneity requires measurements that retain the physical scale and orientation of intratumoral intensity dependence. We evaluate the original 3D variographic field produced by the MUSE tool (Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment) alongside directional radiomics and independent image-based molecular classification. Methods. We analyzed postcontrast T1-weighted magnetic resonance images and enhancing-tumor segmentations from the public UCSF-PDGM collection. Verified MUSE outputs were available for 416 independent baseline patients, of whom 375 had paired directional gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) measurements. Each MUSE field retained 328 original experimental directional variograms with physical lag distances, semivariances, orientations, and voxel-pair support. Agreement was assessed at aligned offsets and through between-tumor comparisons. Patient-level permutation tests evaluated associations with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) status on 2,508 native direction-lag coordinates. A standalone 3D residual convolutional neural network (CNN) provided a separate IDH classification benchmark. Results. At 9,371 geometrically aligned offsets, native MUSE semivariance and half GLCM contrast correlated strongly (Pearson r = 0.954). Across 31,599 eligible between-tumor comparisons, representation-level dissimilarities showed Spearman {rho}_S = 0.862, with sensitivity to GLCM feature family and long-offset sampling support. In 364 grade-4 tumors, including 24 IDH-mutant cases, the original MUSE field was associated with IDH after conventional adjustment (global permutation p = 0.00050), but the association was attenuated after primary directional GLCM adjustment (p = 0.256). The independent CNN achieved an out-of-fold IDH ROC-AUC of 0.792 and PR-AUC of 0.414 across 416 patients. Native MUSE examples revealed scale- and direction-dependent spatial behavior, including distances beyond those sampled by the GLCM protocol. Conclusion. Variograms by MUSE provide a physically indexed description of tumor spatial heterogeneity that can accompany radiomic analysis and CNN classification. The observed statistical overlap is substantial, and incremental clinical discrimination beyond directional GLCM features remains unestablished.
zh_abstract: 【目的】描述胶质瘤异质性需要保留瘤内强度依赖的物理尺度和方向的测量。我们评估由 MUSE 工具（Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment）生成的原始 3D 变异函数场（variographic field），并与方向性影像组学和独立的基于图像的分子分类进行比较。【方法】我们分析了来自公开 UCSF-PDGM 集合的增强后 T1 加权磁共振图像和增强肿瘤分割。416 名独立基线患者有经验证的 MUSE 输出，其中 375 名有配对的方向性灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）测量。每个 MUSE 场保留 328 个原始实验方向变异函数，包含物理滞后距离、半方差、方向和体素对支持。在对齐偏移处以及通过肿瘤间比较评估一致性。患者水平置换检验在 2,508 个原生方向-滞后坐标上评估与异柠檬酸脱氢酶（IDH）状态的关联。一个独立的 3D 残差卷积神经网络（CNN）提供单独的 IDH 分类基准。【结果】在 9,371 个几何对齐偏移处，原生 MUSE 半方差与半数 GLCM 对比度强相关（Pearson r = 0.954）。在 31,599 次符合条件的肿瘤间比较中，表示水平差异显示 Spearman ρ_S = 0.862，并对 GLCM 特征家族和长偏移采样支持敏感。在 364 例 4 级肿瘤中，包括 24 例 IDH 突变病例，原始 MUSE 场在常规调整后与 IDH 相关（全局置换 p = 0.00050），但在主要方向性 GLCM 调整后关联减弱（p = 0.256）。独立 CNN 在 416 名患者中取得 IDH 的折外（out-of-fold）ROC-AUC 为 0.792，PR-AUC 为 0.414。原生 MUSE 示例揭示尺度和方向依赖的空间行为，包括超出 GLCM 协议采样范围的距离。【结论】MUSE 的变异函数提供了肿瘤空间异质性的物理索引描述，可伴随影像组学分析和 CNN 分类。观察到的统计重叠很大，而超出方向性 GLCM 特征的增量临床判别仍未确立。
